sampling: Flag-selected audit, not representative accuracy estimation; 729 unflagged responses not audited. Historical74 and corrective7 reported separately.
units: Each original review reason is addressed; split multi-claim reasons into evidence items. Preserve exact response excerpt and original reason; do not assume all81 false or clear whole response when only some claims checked.
evidence_precedence: Original research and source authors for empirical claims
Official publisher, NASA, agency or vendor documentation for direct statements and versioned features
Secondary sources only when needed and labeled; search snippets/discovery are not full verification
Private inaccessible provenance cannot be established by plausible similar public text
case_outcome_rule: Contradicted if at least one checked assertion has direct contrary evidence; otherwise not_verifiable if no assertions supported; otherwise partly_supported if any unsupported/qualified assertions remain; otherwise supported. Detail-level results govern; summary never means full response validated.
timing: Use claim-specific dates and historical source versions where possible; record current-document limitations; no hindsight inference of feature availability.
bias_control: Casebooks omit scores, generator names, variants and cohort names during evidence assessment, but response content and generation period may reveal them. Analyst has prior context: this is partial masking, not independent blinded validation.
search_process: Record query strings and checked sources; inability to locate is not proof of nonexistence. No unsupported numeric confidence scores.
preservation: Frozen ratings, flags, sources and timeout remain unchanged. Audit statuses are separate annotations. Do not claim interrater reliability or human adjudication.
scope: Factual claims and source attributions implicated by the existing 81 flags and 101 review reasons. No new quality ratings, generation or classification changes.

outcome_semantics.supported: Inspected evidence supports the specific checked assertion within recorded limits.
outcome_semantics.partly_supported: Some content is supported, but qualification or an unresolved part remains.
outcome_semantics.contradicted: At least one checked assertion has direct contrary evidence; this does not mean every assertion in the response is wrong.
outcome_semantics.not_verifiable: Available sources did not establish the checked assertion or its provenance; not proof of fabrication.
outcome_semantics.case_rollup: Any contradicted item -> contradicted; all not_verifiable -> not_verifiable; all supported -> supported; otherwise partly_supported. Partial support counts as some support in the prospective protocol.

publication_projection.findings: All 81 cases, 500 claim findings and 57 source records retained without changes to their evidence statuses, quotations, explanations or references.
publication_projection.full_response_storage: Responses and rating rationales remain in the linked public source files, not duplicated in this audit package.
publication_projection.protocol_projection: Scientific protocol fields are retained. Administrative scope/delivery text is replaced by the scope statement above; no retrospective claim of preregistration or independent blinding is introduced.
